$comment: Keys are suite/case/tool. Entries may be scoped with platforms (array) and path (combined|per-case). A listed failure that starts passing is STALE and fails CI — remove it when the upstream limitation clears. An entry never turns a benchmark validity failure into a ranked PASS.
$comment-discipline: Expected still failing = accepted+reported; expected passing = stale = exit 1; unexpected failure = exit 1. Package upgrades re-run every plant automatically (versions are exactly pinned in package.json).

format/semantics/prettier.why: Reformatting separates from the following inline element with a newline, which Svelte renders as a visible space where the original had none — the formatter changes observable output for zero-space inline sequences.

compile/validity-client/mrwaip-svelte-rs.why: CSS source maps use style-block-relative original lines instead of component-document positions (mapped 2:24 where the token is at 9:24).

compile/validity-server/mrwaip-svelte-rs.why: Server compile returns no js.map at all — the artifact omits the source map the official compiler always emits.

compile/validity-client/rsvelte-wasm.why: JS source-map columns count UTF-8 bytes instead of UTF-16 code units (anchors after a non-BMP emoji shift by +2), and the template anchor has no original mapping.
